properties.headline: A classic brick ranch on a quiet, tree-lined street.
properties.lede: Set on a flat 0.20-acre lot in the Fox Plains subdivision, this 3-bedroom home pairs solid 1979 construction with high-demand features: an updated eat-in kitchen, a versatile finished lower level, stamped patio, and an attached two-car garage.

knowledge.response:
Estimated Utilities:
• Electric (Ameren MO): ~$110–$145/mo avg.
• Gas (Spire): ~$65–$95/mo avg in winter.
• Water/Sewer (Missouri American & MSD): ~$70/mo.
• Trash: Florissant municipal services.
Actual costs vary by personal usage and heating preferences.

Construction & Features:
• Built in 1979 with classic single-story brick veneer and vinyl siding for minimal maintenance.
• 1,300 sq ft on the main level featuring 3 beds & 2 baths.
• Finished Lower Level: Expansive carpeted rec room with built-in wet bar, recessed LED lighting, and dedicated laundry/storage wing.
• Garage: 2-car attached garage with direct interior access.

Neighborhood & Locale:
• School District: Hazelwood School District (Walker Elementary / Hazelwood Central cluster).
• Parks: St. Ferdinand Park (4 min, 64 acres with fishing lake) and Koch Park & Aquatic Center (6 min).
• Commutes: ~14 min to Boeing campus & St. Louis Lambert Airport, ~25 min to Clayton, ~28 min to Downtown St. Louis via I-270.

I can help you arrange a private viewing with listing partner Ava Marchetti! You can fill out the form at the bottom of the page, or email her directly at ava@marchettiestates.com / call (314) 555-0194.

Pricing & Financial Context:
• Offered Price: $254,000 (anchored to recent sales in Fox Plains).
• Estimated Annual Real Estate Taxes: ~$2,600–$2,900/year (St. Louis County).
• HOA: No mandatory master association fee in Fox Plains.
• Financing: Eligible for Conventional, FHA, and VA loan programs.
